baselines: model-sharded data parallelism with conventional GPU-managed collectives
record_under_review.evidence_span: DisDP identifies serial interference among GEMM, network collectives, and optimizer-state storage in model-sharded data parallelism. It fully disaggregates compute, network, and storage, offloads collectives to SmartNICs and SmartSwitches, and uses a SmartSwitch-enhanced parameter server. The abstract reports 3.98x improvement over state-of-the-art training systems on eight GPUs training a 175B model.
record_under_review.hardware_or_process_assumptions: Multi-GPU distributed training with programmable SmartNIC/SmartSwitch infrastructure and parameter-server storage; topology and failure assumptions require full-paper verification.
record_under_review.limits: The evidence is an author preprint abstract; exact baseline systems, network topology, storage cost, parameter-server scaling, failure behavior, and reproduction beyond eight GPUs remain to be verified.
record_under_review.method_or_artifact: Fully disaggregated compute/network/storage architecture, SmartNIC and SmartSwitch collective offload, and a SmartSwitch-enhanced parameter server for optimizer-state storage.
metrics: 3.98x improvement on eight GPUs for a 175B model
collective execution time increase of 41% under aggregated compute/network/storage interference
fewer than 10% of GPU SMs occupied by collectives in the motivating analysis
record_under_review.problem: Model-sharded data-parallel training reduces GPU memory requirements but adds AllGather and ReduceScatter overhead and interference among compute, communication, and optimizer-state storage.
record_under_review.title: DisDP: Disaggregating Compute, Network, and Storage for Model-Sharded Data-Parallel Training
record_under_review.workload_or_benchmark: Model-sharded LLM training, including a reported 175B model on eight distributed GPUs; the abstract references Llama and DeepSeek-style pretraining workloads.
